other_conditions: Applicant must be engaged in building or construction work
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Worker must have at least one year of regular membership and an active membership with the Board
Child must be receiving coaching for admission in professional/technical courses
Assistance can be provided for up to three children per worker
Financial assistance can be availed only once per child
Worker must not have previously applied for financial assistance for the same child
Spouse must not have received any financial assistance for coaching classes of their child from any government department/board/corporate institution
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 for coaching classes and ₹1,00,000 for UPSC/HPSSC Main exam preparation.
